arts.ttl: Sassuolo vs. Pisa, the final game of matchday 12
arts.sum: The head-to-head record in Emilia between the two teams is 3 matches: Sassuolo unbeaten with 2 wins (the last 1-0 in last year`s Serie B) and 1 draw (the last 0-0 in Serie C1 2006/07). Matchday twelve of Serie A will close out at the Mapei Stadium with Sassuolo hosting Pisa.

The two teams promoted from Serie B last season meet on Monday with both sides separated by seven points in their first season back in Serie A. It is Sassuolo who have had the better start to the sea...
